summary: Yimutian Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting an additional closing under an existing securities purchase agreement. The company issued and sold a senior convertible promissory note with a principal amount of $933,333 to the same investor, at an initial conversion price of $2.12 per ADS, maturing September 8, 2027. This is the fourth tranche under the agreement, which allows for up to $30 million aggregate principal. The note includes customary covenants, including a minimum cash balance of $500,000, and an interest rate increase to 19% upon default. The offering was made under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D. This is a routine financing event, not a special situation.
